name: Inquiry with benefits
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Inquiry with benefits.
Choose a split or stacked inquiry layout, then add benefits and trust badges beside the native contact form.
Requests are handled by Shopify. No CRM endpoint, external script or booking provider is required.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Uses Shopify’s native contact form. This sends an inquiry; it does not reserve a time, create a booking, or connect to a CRM.
